mechanism: directional continuation after a pre-existing impulse and bounded consolidation resolves through a prior range extreme
payer_constraint: stop clustering and delayed counterparty repositioning around salient breakout levels; hypothesis only
entry_event: closed-bar break of a predeclared prior range with EMA trend alignment, compact pre-break box and anti-chase bound
regime_no_trade: no trend alignment, oversized consolidation, stale/missing data, ambiguous dual-side trigger, or cost budget below minimum
timeframe: 1h structural baseline; future economic horizon must be separately frozen
side_policy: symmetric long/short; no long bias in structural policy
invalidation: 1.25 ATR initial structural stop; no adverse add
exit_policy: 48-bar time stop; favorable-progress ATR/structure trailing and runner allowed; no fixed outcome-derived TP
sizing_turnover: 0.5% equity risk capped at 15% notional; one entry per transition, 2-bar cooldown
cost_handling: verified round-trip cost authority required; structural move budget must be >=1.25x verified cost

sources.limitation: FX order data; crypto portability unproven

sources.role: separate directional persistence from volatility sizing

sources.limitation: fees do not model realized slippage

falsification: prospective continuation intent must add positive net contribution over direction-flip, time-placebo and delayed-entry controls under frozen realistic costs; otherwise reject this specification
